faq.question: What does Khairul mean?
faq.answer: Khairul is associated with the Arabic form خَيْرُ الْخَلْق, whose core sense is khairul; best of creation (malay form).

faq.question: What is the origin of Khairul?
faq.answer: Khairul is associated with Arabic. Khairul is the Malay form of Arabic خَيْرُ الْخَلْق (Khayr al-Khalq), meaning 'best of creation'.

faq.question: Is Khairul an Arabic name?
faq.answer: Yes — the underlying form خَيْرُ الْخَلْق is Arabic.

faq.question: Is Khairul an Islamic name?
faq.answer: Khairul can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.question: Is Khairul a Quranic name?
faq.answer: Khairul should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Khayr al-Khalq is a compound of Arabic elements, not itself a Quranic personal name.
